## Featured Projects

These projects represent several stages of my development in GIS, cartography, spatial analysis, research, and community service. They include work completed at Roane State Community College, the University of New Mexico, and through volunteer partnerships with schools, nonprofit organizations, and professional associations.

::: {#featured-projects}
:::
